name: io.github.NeoReader/sizla
title: siz.la
description: Make short links and QR codes and read click stats from your AI assistant.

tools.name: shorten_link
tools.description: Make a short siz.la address for a long web address. Returns the short address and the link's id. Safety checks run on every destination, and the account's monthly link limit applies. Password, expiry and click limits work on every plan, the free one included. It can also put the link in a campaign and fire the account's ad pixels on each click.

destination.description: The full web address to shorten. It must start with http:// or https://.

code.description: A custom code for the short address, for example lunch-menu. Letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. Leave it out to get a random one.

domain.description: One of the account's connected custom domains, such as go.example.com, to make the link on. Leave it out to use siz.la.

campaign.description: A campaign to put the link in, by name. A campaign that does not exist yet is made. Needs a paid plan.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working, as a date and time such as 2026-12-31 18:00.

password.description: A password visitors must enter before they are sent on.

title.description: A name for the link. Only the account owner sees it.

cta_id.description: The id of one of the account's call-to-action messages (made on siz.la under Call to action) to show over the page the link opens.

pixels.description: Ids of the account's ad pixels to fire on each click, as listed by list_pixels.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List the account's links, newest first, with code, short address, destination, clicks and creation date. Search by part of the code, destination or title.

q.description: Text to look for in the code, destination or title.

page.description: Which page of results to return.

per_page.description: How many links to return on a page.

status.description: Which links to list: active or archived.

tools.name: get_link_stats
tools.description: Show how a link is doing: total and unique clicks, new and returning visitors, clicks by day, busiest hours of the week, top countries, top referrers, visits from AI assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude, browsers, systems and devices. For a bio page it also gives views and clicks for each button, and on a paid plan the conversions. Visits from bots are reported apart and are not in the totals.

id.description: The link's id, as returned by list_links or shorten_link. Give either id or code.

code.description: The link's code (the part after siz.la/) or its full short address. Give either id or code.

days.description: How many days back to report: 7, 30 or 90. The plan may keep less history than that.

tools.name: get_conversions
tools.description: Show the sign-ups and sales counted against a link's clicks: how many, what share of clicks they are, their value for each currency, and the newest ones. Leave out the link to cover the whole account. Needs a paid plan.

id.description: The link's id, as returned by list_links or shorten_link. Give either id or code.

code.description: The link's code (the part after siz.la/) or its full short address. Give either id or code.

days.description: How many days back to report: 7, 30 or 90.

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Change one of the account's links. Only the fields you send change. The short address stays the same. Expiry, password and click limit work on every plan. It can also change the campaign and the pixels. Leave pixels out to keep them as they are; send an empty list to remove them.

id.description: The link's id, as returned by list_links or shorten_link. Give either id or code.

code.description: The link's code (the part after siz.la/) or its full short address. Give either id or code.

destination.description: The new full web address the link leads to. It must start with http:// or https://.

title.description: A new name for the link. Send an empty string to remove it.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working, as a date and time such as 2026-12-31 18:00. Send an empty string to remove the expiry.

password.description: A password visitors must enter before they are sent on. Send an empty string to remove it.

click_limit.description: The link stops working after this many clicks. Send 0 to remove the limit.

cta_id.description: The id of one of the account's call-to-action messages to show over the page the link opens. Send 0 to remove it.

campaign.description: Move the link into a campaign, by name. A campaign that does not exist yet is made. Send an empty string to take the link out of its campaign.

pixels.description: Ids of the account's ad pixels to fire on each click, as listed by list_pixels. An empty list removes them.

tools.name: archive_link
tools.description: Move a link to the archive. It keeps working and keeps its stats; it is only hidden from the main list. Restore it with restore_link.

id.description: The link's id, as returned by list_links or shorten_link. Give either id or code.

code.description: The link's code (the part after siz.la/) or its full short address. Give either id or code.

tools.name: restore_link
tools.description: Bring an archived link back to the main list.

id.description: The link's id, as returned by list_links or shorten_link. Give either id or code.

code.description: The link's code (the part after siz.la/) or its full short address. Give either id or code.

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Delete a link and its stats for good. The short address stops working and cannot be used again. This cannot be undone, so confirm with the person first. To keep the stats, use archive_link instead.

id.description: The link's id, as returned by list_links or shorten_link. Give either id or code.

code.description: The link's code (the part after siz.la/) or its full short address. Give either id or code.

tools.name: make_qr_code
tools.description: Get the address of a QR code image for one of the account's links. The image is an SVG. Scans count as clicks on the link.

id.description: The link's id, as returned by list_links or shorten_link. Give either id or code.

code.description: The link's code (the part after siz.la/) or its full short address. Give either id or code.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List the domains the account can shorten links on: siz.la and any connected custom domains.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List the account's campaigns with how many links each holds and their clicks over the last 30 days.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Make a campaign to group links, read their clicks together and give them shared UTM values. Put links in it with the campaign option of shorten_link or update_link.

name.description: The campaign's name. It must be different from the account's other campaigns.

utm_source.description: Added to the address of every link in the campaign as utm_source.

tools.name: update_campaign
tools.description: Rename a campaign or change its UTM values. Only the fields you send change. New UTM values reach a link the next time it is saved or added to the campaign.

id.description: The campaign's id, as returned by list_campaigns.

utm_source.description: A new utm_source. Send an empty string to remove it.

utm_medium.description: A new utm_medium. Send an empty string to remove it.

utm_campaign.description: A new utm_campaign. Send an empty string to remove it.

tools.name: list_pixels
tools.description: List the account's ad pixels with their ids, to pass as "pixels" when shortening or updating a link.

tools.name: check_link
tools.description: Check any siz.la short address, whoever owns it: whether it exists, was removed, or has expired, and where it leads. It never shows the destination of a password-protected link and never says who owns a link.

link.description: A siz.la short address such as https://siz.la/lunch-menu, or just its code.
